digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Five prose upgrades to implement-side skill and test-design doc address largest escape classes: parity siblings at build time, config read-but-miswired, op-level contention semantics, gate findings without oracle upgrades, and known gaps at close
Surface-parity census (section 4a) enumerates five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) each dispositioned in-scope-and-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason
Config-effect contrast tests (test-design §6) prove each config key CHANGES BEHAVIOR through real read path (default vs non-default), targeting read-but-miswired class

Contention triggers (section 4b) route three case-c shapes to existing shared suites: composed/check-then-act writes to test_concurrency_regression.py, write-storm/retry to test_store_concurrency.py, read-integrity to test_reads_under_sync_contention.py
Behavioral gate findings receive RED test FIRST then fix in same change; non-behavioral findings fixed directly with exemption stated
Phase-5 residual-gap disposition sweep enumerates out-of-scope slots and compromises with forced-artifact wording: filed/accepted-with-reason/fixed or none
